бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

examples.text: Я пришла принести вам наши самые глубокие извинения.
examples.trans: I've come to bring you our deepest apologies.

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

meanings.note: + infinitive: давай убирать = let's clean up

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

examples.trans: A rush began in the kitchen.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.en: to step aside, to move back

examples.trans: He stepped over to the window.

meanings.en: to move over, shift slightly, make room

спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.
